data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 104.389 million for the year ended 31 December 2024, representing a 48.07% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development is primarily attributed to positive releases from prior accident years and good loss experience, as well as significant improvement on closed year reserves for the 2022 and 2023 years of account. The report mentions several named catastrophe events, including Hurricanes Helene and Milton in 2024 and 2023, and Hurricane Ian, Winter Storm Elliott, Wildfires in Hawaii, Hurricane Fiona, and Tropical Cyclone Gabrielle in 2022. The impact of the California Wildfires in January 2025 was also considered for the 2023 year of account closure.

The 2022 YoA has incurred several catastrophe events... The strength of the premium base and low levels of non catastrophe losses have helped generate a healthy profit for the year. The year has also benefited from reserve releases from prior years of account.
